signal_definitions.LIVE1M2_NO_TRADE: Zero position and zero friction, control
signal_definitions.LIVE1M2_USDJPY_INVERSE_3M: Position opposite to the sum of the last three closed one-minute USDJPY returns
signal_definitions.LIVE1M2_GBPUSD_MOMENTUM_3M: Position in the sign of the sum of the last three closed one-minute GBPUSD returns
signal_definitions.LIVE1M2_GBPUSD_USDJPY_CONSENSUS_3M: Trade only when inverse USDJPY and positive GBPUSD return votes agree; otherwise flat
signal_definitions.LIVE1M2_EURUSD_MOMENTUM_CONFIRMED_2SOURC: Take EURUSD three-minute momentum only when the two-source dollar-pressure consensus agrees
signal_definitions.LIVE1M2_EUR_GBP_DIVERGENCE_Z15: Contrarian EURUSD-minus-GBPUSD relative-return z-score using a trailing 24 one-minute-return window; threshold 1.5
signal_definitions.LIVE1M2_EURUSD_CATCHUP_2SOURCE: Trade with two-source consensus only when EURGBP divergence is extreme and implies catch-up

inference_plan.multiple_testing: Benjamini-Hochberg across the seven frozen v2 candidates
inference_plan.required_survival: positive net mean after assumed friction, 95% block-bootstrap lower bound above zero, BH-adjusted p below 0.05, and at least 200 trades

scientific_boundary: Separate forward family. No DXY input, no backfilled predictions, no live broker orders, and no profitability claim.
